spec.title: Downtime Root Cause Analysis
spec.description:
**Pareto Fault Distribution**

- **Namespace:** `S7-1500 OPC UA (ns=4)`
- **Monitored Flags:** `HighSort`, `S2_GripperFault`, `LowProduction`, `EStop`, `Fault`

Ranks cumulative fault occurrences to prioritize maintenance actions on the most frequent bottleneck.

spec.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^Alarm_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /${Station:raw}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  // Detect rising edges (0 -> 1 transitions) and sum them to count discrete occurrences
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  // Clean up the name: "Alarm_S2_GripperFault" -> "S2_GripperFault"
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with Alarm: strings.replaceAll(v: r._measurement, t: "Alarm_", u: "") }))
  // Ungroup into a single table so Grafana creates one bar per row
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["Alarm", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

spec.title: Reliability KPIs (MTTR & MTBF)
spec.description:
**Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Indicators**

- **MTBF:** `(Planned Time - Downtime) / Fault Events` (Mean Time Between Failures)
- **MTTR:** `Total Downtime / Fault Events` (Mean Time To Repair)

Computed dynamically via Flux rising-edge detection (`0 ➔ 1`) across all boolean alarm streams.

spec.query:
// 1. Count total rising-edge fault events across all Alarm_ tags
faultEvents = from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^Alarm_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

// Safe divisor: defaults to 1 if 0 faults occurred to avoid NaN
numFaults = if exists faultEvents._value and faultEvents._value > 0 then float(v: faultEvents._value) else 1.0

// 2. Fetch latest Downtime and compute MTTR & MTBF
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Downtime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      MTTR_sec: float(v: r._value) / numFaults,
      // Assumes 600s (10min Demo Shift) planned window minus Downtime
      MTBF_sec: (600.0 - float(v: r._value)) / numFaults
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["MTTR_sec", "MTBF_sec"])

spec.title: Cycle Time Stability vs. Takt Time
spec.description:
**Micro-Stop & Bottleneck Detection**

- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.CycleTime`
- **Takt Time Threshold:** `8.0 s` (Red Dashed Line)

Spikes above `8.0 s` indicate mechanical hesitation or pneumatic lag at the S2 two-axis pick-and-place cell.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "CycleTime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: IIoT Pipeline Health
spec.description:
**OT-to-IT Telemetry Observability**

- **Architecture:** `S7-1500 OPC UA ➔ Node-RED ➔ Kafka ➔ InfluxDB`
- **Ingestion Rate:** Real-time message throughput (`msg/s`)
- **Stream Lag:** End-to-end latency (`ms`) from PLC sample to database query

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ 
      _value: float(v: r._value) / 60.0, 
      _measurement: "Ingestion Rate (msg/s)" 
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_measurement"])

spec.title: OEE
spec.description:
**Overall Equipment Effectiveness (ISO 22400)**

- **Formula:** `Availability × Performance × Yield`
- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.OEE` (`FC50_KPIs`)
- **Target:** `≥ 85%` (World-Class Benchmark)

Tracks global manufacturing efficiency across S1 Sorting, S2 Assembly, and S3 Palletizing cells.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "OEE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()

spec.title: Performance
spec.description:
**Speed Efficiency**

- **Formula:** `(Actual Production × Ideal Cycle Time) / Operating Time`
- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.Performance`
- **Target:** `≥ 95%`

Evaluates line operating speed against theoretical design speed, exposing micro-stops and sensor lag.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()

spec.title: Availability
spec.description:
**Line Uptime Ratio**

- **Formula:** `(Planned Shift Time - Downtime) / Planned Shift Time`
- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.Availability`
- **Target:** `≥ 90%`

Measures the percentage of scheduled shift time the line runs without unscheduled stops or E-Stop events.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Availability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()

spec.title: Yield
spec.description:
**First-Pass Quality Rate**

- **Formula:** `Good Assembled Parts / Total Parts Entered`
- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.Yield`
- **Target:** `≥ 95%`

Tracks the ratio of compliant parts passing S1 colour vision sorting through to S3 packaging.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Yield")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()

spec.title: Throughput & Sort Rate
spec.description:
**Dynamic Flow & Sorting Correlation**

- **Throughput Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.Throughput` (`parts/min` - Left Axis)
- **Sort Rate Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.SortRate` (`%` - Right Axis)

Correlates overall line production velocity against the S1 vision sorting ratio to detect infeed bottlenecks.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Throughput" or r["_measurement"] == "SortRate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Production Counters
spec.description:
**Real-Time Shift Volumetrics**

- **CycleTime:** Latest completed assembly cycle duration (`s`)
- **LoadedPalletCount:** Full pallets exited at S3 Palletizer
- **ProductionCount:** Total finished assemblies (`DB50_KPIs`)
- **SortedCount:** Raw items routed by S1 Colour Sorter

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ProductionCount" or r["_measurement"] == "SortedCount" or r["_measurement"] == "LoadedPalletCount" or r["_measurement"] == "CycleTime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> last()

spec.title: Line State Panel
spec.description:
**Machine State Timeline**

- **PLC Tag:** `DB50_KPIs.Status` (`UInt16`)
- **`0` (Green):** Line Running
- **`1` (Orange):** Alarm Active
- **`2` (Red):** Emergency Stop

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

spec.title: Active Alarms Counter
spec.description:
**Cumulative Fault & Stoppage Tracker**

- **ActiveAlarms:** `DB50_KPIs.ActiveAlarms` (Current active fault count)
- **Downtime:** `DB50_KPIs.Downtime` (Cumulative shift stoppage in seconds)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smartline_kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ActiveAlarms" or r["_measurement"] == "Downtime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> last()
